uv adopted; hatchling kept; uv.lock committed; docs updated; tests/build verified
swissTLM3D core-nav vector slice implemented (CLI-only ogr2ogr->GeoJSON->OSM) and verified end-to-end on real sample data. Deferred items split into 9t0/unr/ktq.
mkgmap.build_img_cmd now runs --gmapsupp with family/product/mapname; pipeline copies the self-contained gmapsupp.img. Rebuilt sample -> 62K gmapsupp with detail+overview subfiles. 25 tests pass.

Broadened the swissTLM3D tag map (table-driven _KIND_TABLES): added railways (TLM_EISENBAHN), aerialways (TLM_UEBRIGE_BAHN), full land cover (TLM_BODENBEDECKUNG: water/forest/scrub/rock/scree/glacier/wetland), POIs (TLM_EINZELOBJEKT: spring/cave/monument/cross/waterfall/...), and walls (TLM_MAUER). Authoritative OBJEKTART codes from the swisstopo Objektkatalog. Verified end-to-end on sample GDB; 27 tests pass.

DEM-optional + splitter implemented and verified end-to-end. Vector-only build derives bounds from the TLM extent (vector.tlm_bounds via ogrinfo + gdaltransform), skips HGT, runs mkgmap without --dem. Large OSM (> SPLIT_NODE_THRESHOLD nodes) is tiled with splitter.jar (auto-downloaded, SHA-pinned) then mkgmap combines tiles into one gmapsupp. Required fixing OSM node ordering for splitter (ascending positive ids, nodes-before-ways). Verified: small sample vector-only (4s) and a 40x30km subset -> 5.16M nodes -> 4 tiles -> 6.8M gmapsupp. 30 tests pass.

Built a whole-Switzerland hillshade from Copernicus GLO-30 (18 tiles, EPSG:4326, --source-epsg 4326): valid 90MB gmapsupp.img with DEM+TYP subfiles in ~52s, fully offline (mkgmap/splitter cached). Documented the coarse-DEM choice (Copernicus GLO-30 / swissALTI3D 2m, geoid datum caveat) in README 'Choosing a DEM source'. 38 tests pass incl. doc guards. On-device/QMapShack visual check still pending (no GUI here), tracked with the other hillshade visual checks.

Built whole-Switzerland DEM+vector gmapsupp (252MB, swiss-glo30-tlm.img): GLO-30 reprojected to EPSG:2056 (to match swissTLM3D) + the 5.3GB whole-CH GDB. 8 layers -> 166.9M nodes -> splitter 112 tiles (16g heap) -> mkgmap with DEM+TYP -> valid gmapsupp (TRE/RGN/LBL/NET/NOD/DEM/TYP/MDR) in ~31min. Documented the combine-with-swissTLM3D workflow + CRS caveat in README. 38 tests pass. Hit + filed the shared --source-epsg limitation (topovert-0zt). On-device visual check still pending (no GUI).

Implemented CRS auto-detection. source_epsg defaults to None: warp_tile_cmd + ogr_geojson_cmd omit -s_srs (GDAL/OGR read the file's own CRS); tlm_bounds detects the layer WKT via ogrinfo -json and passes it to gdaltransform (robust to the compound LV95+LN02 CRS). --source-epsg kept as a both-inputs override. Verified end-to-end: 4326 GLO-30 + 2056 swissTLM3D with no --source-epsg -> features at correct WGS84 coords, valid img. 40 tests pass; README workaround removed.
